per_item_findings.question: Is the source a visible account area, a platform response, or an application-local value?
per_item_findings.finding: NOT OBSERVED for the target session this round. Statically, the only identity-bearing surfaces that exist as candidate locations are the page's visible account area and its normal page-load identity responses; every value the runtime actually uses today is application-local.

per_item_findings.question: Does the field denote a shop, a login account, a sub-account, or only a display name?
per_item_findings.finding: UNKNOWN - no field was observed. The only prior-observed label ('主账号') denotes a view of the main account, not a data field, and a display name is in any case never an identity.

per_item_findings.question: What shows it belongs to the current logged-in session rather than a customer or another object?
per_item_findings.finding: UNKNOWN / NOT ESTABLISHED. The only session-attribution mechanism implemented today compares application-generated values (sessionId, local shopId, documentGeneration); nothing ties a platform identity value to the session.

per_item_findings.question: How is it tied to this session, target and document generation?
per_item_findings.finding: Implemented for runtime evidence only: the document binding (sessionId, local shopId, documentGeneration) plus the admission connection evidence hash. Any future identity evidence must be recorded against that same binding and must expire with the session/document generation.

per_item_findings.question: Does an external reference actually exist?
per_item_findings.finding: NOT OBSERVED. The Owner states no separate numeric identifier string exists; the local data has no platform_accounts row at all, so no external reference is stored anywhere today. If one is supplied it is an opaque string (no numeric-format requirement) and must never be treated as platform-verified by itself.

per_item_findings.question: Is there evidence of uniqueness or cross-session stability?
per_item_findings.finding: NO. A single observation could not establish this in any case; uniqueness and cross-session stability remain explicitly UNVERIFIED and require repeated, independently authorized observations.
